scope: Evidence-based cosmetic-role rules for the BF6 1.4.3.0 weapon/attachment audit. Catalog-family census and representative EBX declared-type checks; no pixel/art review or runtime claims.

correction.correction: An asset may be cosmetic-only while consumed in multiplayer. MP use does not disqualify its cosmetic role. Exclude only the appearance-only branch from gameplay-mechanics analysis after positive type/content and reference evidence shows no configuration, compatibility, combat, handling, ammunition, optic, or other gameplay role. Preserve MP availability/ownership links.
correction.priorReport: The dated namespace report is preserved. This supplement corrects its overly restrictive no-MP-consumer exclusion criterion.

method.familyCounts: Count capture/weapon-audit-2026-09-23/asset-catalog.json assets[] whose path.casefold() begins common/hardware/weapons/ and matches case-insensitive slash-segment family regexes. Counts overlap and are catalog records.
method.typeReview: Decode representative RIFF EBX bodies with scripts/frosty-ebx-decode.py and the Head 4892087 hotfix SharedTypeDescriptors. Map Class_* hashes through descriptor GUID prefixes to FrostyPlugin/Sdk/ClassGuids.txt using the same GUID convention as scripts/frosty-material-grid-inventory.py. Report unique names only; retain decoder ambiguity/unresolved markers.
limits: Lexical paths discover families; they do not prove cosmetic-only role.
Representative type checks do not estimate type proportions within families.
Raw coverage is complete for the weapon namespace, but reference closure and visual interaction review are bounded.
SQL ledger totals supplied by the operator (24017 captured, 22150 decoded) were not re-derived here; namespace capture coverage is independently counted from raw-status files.

rules.rule: Exclude a positively identified charm-only unlock or visual branch from recoil, damage, ammunition, compatibility, and weapon-stat effect searches. An expected MP consumer is allowed; preserve MP ownership/availability links.
rules.exceptions: Do not drop the whole folder. It contains 524 lower-case ob-prefixed and 16 OB-prefixed records, plus 261 U-prefixed wrappers. A decoded charm OB_WEPCHRM_LegendaryBenchmark_3p.physics is PhysicsAsset. Retain charm model, physics, animation, collision, attachment parent, and sightline records for relevant visual/interaction analysis. Do not infer harmlessness from CHE/CHL/CHR names.

rules.rule: Mark a concrete leaf appearance-only when declared type/content and its reference path establish it as a skin material or visual variation, with no functional weapon/attachment fields. It may have MP consumers. Retain the skin-to-weapon relation as availability metadata.
rules.exceptions: Never exclude the subtree or all U/OV/OB records. A decoded T asset is TextureAsset, U_MDV is UnlockAsset, and M250 skin OV is ObjectVariation. UnlockAsset describes a wrapper; ObjectVariation can select mesh as well as material. Follow the exact child refs. Retain geometry, physics, optic, compatibility, and gameplay-bearing children until independently classified.

rules.rule: A TextureAsset can be excluded from mechanics extraction when refs prove it is only a camo/material assignment. MP use does not change that role.
rules.exceptions: Resolve U and SPO wrappers and their referenced content; tokens are not mode proof. Keep render data for visibility, emissive, scope, or sight-contrast review.

rules.rule: A decal texture leaf may be marked cosmetic for combat-stat analysis after ref closure confirms an appearance-only decal assignment.
rules.exceptions: Keep U_WEPDEC unlock/assignment links. Retain visual review when placement or contrast can affect identification, reticle clarity, or sightlines. T/U/SPO alone is insufficient.

rules.rule: No directory-wide cosmetic exclusion. Preserve base weapon geometry, model blueprints, functional attachment parts, and owner links in their appropriate geometry, compatibility, and gameplay branches.
rules.exceptions: A decoded SV98M base graph contains ObjectBlueprint, StaticModelEntityData, and PartComponentData; decoder marks layouts ambiguous. Retain without interpreting offsets. Charm physics and skin ObjectVariation samples also require branch-specific decisions.

rules.rule: Keep optic/sight WPM branches, sight alignment, zoom, reticle, and anti-glint/lens-flare selector sources even if the optic also has cosmetic children. Filter a proven appearance-only child texture separately.
rules.exceptions: Reviewed source connects WPM_NoScopeGlint through a selector-gated modifier to WeaponLensFlareData_NoFlare. A separate report reviews M2010 SDO/LERT and RMR riser fields. These reports do not establish native activation; preserve the source branches.

labels.cosmetic_only: Type/content and refs establish appearance-only role; MP consumer allowed.
labels.cosmetic_visual_review: Appearance branch retained for geometry, collision, visibility, sightline, reticle, or optic-render review.
labels.gameplay_candidate: Branch carries compatibility, modifiers, ammo, handling, combat, optic, or other gameplay configuration.
labels.unresolved: Incomplete refs/body, ambiguous layout, missing role review, or mode uncertainty; keep candidate.
